description: Results for one specific publication, designated by its uuid, broken down per network (views, likes, comments, shares, engagement, tracked clicks). Unlike get_top_posts there is no ranking cut-off, so a post that performed poorly is still returned. Read-only. — FR : résultats d'une publication précise par uuid, ventilés par réseau.
